strings.name: Patrizio Bertelli
strings.role: Prada Group Chairman, Executive Director and former Co-CEO
strings.summary: Patrizio Bertelli began in leather goods and worked with Miuccia Prada to develop Prada’s production system and international business network. He stepped down as Co-CEO in 2023 and subsequently became Chairman; the Group completed its Versace acquisition during his chairmanship. He also co-founded Fondazione Prada and launched the Luna Rossa America’s Cup challenge project.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. The Co-CEO departure, first chairmanship and subsequent term are distinguished; acquisition completion is not completed integration, and honorary qualifications are separated from earned degrees.
strings.influence.rationale: Worked with design teams to develop Prada Group, building international luxury brands and commercial networks.
strings.facts.f1.label: Leadership transition
strings.facts.f1.value: Ended his Co-CEO role on 26 January 2023, when Andrea Guerra became CEO. First became Chairman on 27 April; a subsequent term began on 24 April 2024.
strings.facts.f2.label: Academic honors
strings.facts.f2.value: Received an honorary Business Economics degree from the University of Florence in 2000 and the University of Bologna’s University Seal in 2021; the latter is not a graduation degree.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Developing an international luxury business
strings.highlights.h1.text: Worked with Miuccia Prada to develop production and distribution; the Group listed in Hong Kong in 2011.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Supporting culture and sailing
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded Fondazione Prada with Miuccia Prada and launched a sailing challenge in 1997 for the 2000 America’s Cup.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Comments on manufacturing and markets
strings.timeline.t1.text: In the nine-month revenue announcement, spoke as Chairman about manufacturing capabilities and continuing market uncertainty.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Group completes Versace acquisition
strings.timeline.t2.text: Prada announced completion of its acquisition of Versace from Capri after regulatory approvals.
strings.timeline.t3.title: First appointed Chairman
strings.timeline.t3.text: Moved from his previous Co-CEO role to Chairman; the 2024 date refers to a subsequent term.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Ends Co-CEO role
strings.timeline.t4.text: The period of shared CEO duties with Miuccia Prada ended, and Andrea Guerra became CEO.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Group lists in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.t5.text: Prada S.p.A. entered the Hong Kong stock market, a Group financing and governance milestone.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Launches America’s Cup challenge
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established the Prada Challenge project for the 2000 America’s Cup, later known as Luna Rossa.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founds cultural institution
strings.timeline.t7.text: With Miuccia Prada, established the cultural institution to which Fondazione Prada traces its origins, supporting art and research.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Begins partnership with Miuccia Prada
strings.timeline.t8.text: The official history dates their partnership to 1977, working together on the brand’s international development.
